test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: DJM is related to BHK in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, JNP is related to HLN. To which of the following is HFD related following the same logic?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/599826d4ebc8da50b159cdc3c0db3819d65ad57c7aa46526310af2686560f282.png] ​

**Logic: '2' is subtracted from the positional value of each alphabet.**

DJM is related to BHK →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f84c9f3d9bac4ba687575e4011674eca984d1f1292420704b31247a9570c8c8.png] 

JNP is related to HLN →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5be7a1b7e1ba29acd34bf7abe1d7366714480c59d7d1c3d1bb6a74eff9b1794.png] 

Similarly, 'HFD' will be related to:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cc7acc6aa13a0d9411e4c352f6a18fb074428d9e1e971de1a615a3be9f305ea.png] 

Here, 'HFD' is related to **'FDB'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
